items.referenceRole: Warm rendering only; architecture designed independently
items.prompt: Create ONE replacement game sprite: a practical small COW BARN on a real farm, isolated on genuine transparent alpha background. Style: warm hand-painted casual farming RPG, thin restrained brown outlines, natural muted colors, clean readable details, NOT photorealistic, not a toy shop. Use the attached wheat icon ONLY as a palette/brush rendering reference. Architecture MUST be a humble working farm barn: simple rectangular RED WEATHERED VERTICAL WOOD siding, a STRAIGHT dark charcoal GALVANIZED STANDING-SEAM METAL GABLE ROOF with flat straight panels and a straight ridge, shallow eaves, cream X-braced double timber barn doors, one tiny ventilation opening, two modest hay bales beside the entrance. NO ceramic tiles, NO curved or wavy tile rows, NO Korean/Chinese/Japanese tiled roof, NO upturned eaves, NO ornamental ridge caps, NO temple/hanok/shopfront architecture, NO flowerpots, lanterns, garlands, scroll signs, awnings, faces, writing or decorative crest. Camera is HIGH top-down orthographic farming RPG view, approximately 65-70 degrees from above, so most of the roof surface is visible and the front wall is shallow at the bottom; NOT a front elevation and NOT an isometric diamond. Front edge horizontal, rectangular square-tile footprint, squat usable agricultural proportions. One compact building for a 2x2 square tile footprint, complete silhouette centered at bottom-center ground contact, ample 12% clear margins all around, no ground plane, scenery, cast shadow, particles, text, grids, matte fringe or background pixels. Let the doors and metal roof immediately read as a REAL FARM BARN.
